statement.name: dummy
statement.type:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X],
  (∃ X₁ X₂,
      IsClosed X₁ ∧
        IsClosed X₂ ∧ ↑(X₁ ∪ X₂) = X ∧ TopologicalSpace.MetrizableSpace ↑X₁ ∧ TopologicalSpace.MetrizableSpace ↑X₂) →
    TopologicalSpace.MetrizableSpace X

comparison.candUnfolded:
∀ {X : Type u_0} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X],
  (∃ X₁ X₂,
      IsClosed X₁ ∧
        IsClosed X₂ ∧ ↑(X₁ ∪ X₂) = X ∧ TopologicalSpace.MetrizableSpace ↑X₁ ∧ TopologicalSpace.MetrizableSpace ↑X₂) →
    TopologicalSpace.MetrizableSpace X
comparison.refUnfolded:
∀ (X : Type u_0) [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X] (X1 X2 : Set X),
  IsClosed X1 →
    IsClosed X2 →
      X1 ∪ X2 = Set.univ →
        TopologicalSpace.MetrizableSpace ↑X1 → TopologicalSpace.MetrizableSpace ↑X2 → TopologicalSpace.MetrizableSpace X
